audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart gives Gragas rows 3, 4-5, first item and 2+ items, contradicting both the packet chart and the whys printed under them (whys[2] and [3] describe Irelia out-trading, whys[5] calls it even, whys[6] gives her the 2-item duel).
audit.why: 46.95% over 443 games. Packet chart: Skill, Gragas, Irelia, Irelia, Gragas, Skill, Irelia — which is exactly what the existing explanations say.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Skill, Gragas, Irelia, Irelia, Gragas, Skill, Irelia, flipped as one atomic group across both layers.

audit.why: Spikes match kit timings: Gragas at 2 (Barrel Roll 10/9/8/7/6s, Drunken Rage 5s) and at 6 (Explosive Cask 100/85/70s); Irelia's window is 3-5 once Flawless Duet (16/14.5/13/11.5/10s) joins Bladesurge resets, then 2+ items.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three fields tell the player to fight around Defiant Dance being down, as if it blocked his combo. Riot's text says it reduces PHYSICAL damage during the charge — Barrel Roll, Drunken Rage's empowered auto and Body Slam are magic, so her W does not blunt his combo at all.
audit.why: Irelia W: 'She takes reduced physical damage during the charge.' Gragas's damage is magic across Q, W and E. Waiting out her W wastes his level-6 window for nothing.
audit.corrected: Ignore Defiant Dance timing — it only cuts physical damage; your Q, W and E are magic, so commit at 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1] ('Get E-stunned') and report[5] describe Flawless Duet only as 'her engage CC' and never state what makes it lane-deciding: it Marks you, and a Marked target refreshes Bladesurge.
audit.why: Irelia Q: 'If the target is Marked or dies to Bladesurge, its cooldown refreshes.' Irelia E: enemies caught between the blades are 'damaged, stunned and Marked.' The stun is the start of a reset chain, not a single CC.
audit.corrected: Flawless Duet stuns and Marks you, refreshing her Bladesurge — dodge it, then E-Q burst her.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing recorded about Irelia's E carrying a 'grounding' derived flag.
audit.why: Riot's own description of Flawless Duet says only damaged, stunned and Marked — no grounding. The derived flag contradicts the description, so per the rule the description wins and no grounding claim reaches the page.

edits.before: Hit your level 6 E-W-Q + Explosive Cask all-in while her W (Defiant Dance) block is on cooldown
edits.after: Ignore Defiant Dance timing — it only cuts physical damage; your Q, W and E are magic, so commit at 6

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Flawless Duet stuns from 850 range and Marks you for her Q reset.

edits.before: Track Irelia's Flawless Duet (Stun): Her engage CC. Dodge it. When it is down — E-Q burst her.
edits.after: Flawless Duet stuns and Marks you, refreshing her Bladesurge — dodge it, then E-Q burst her.

notes: Biggest find: Defiant Dance reduces PHYSICAL damage only, and every point of Gragas's kit is magic — yet whys[4], mid and wants.you[2] all told the player to time his all-in around her W being down. Corrected in wants.you[2]; whys[4] and mid still carry the same false premise but sit outside a safe length band for a full rewrite, so they are flagged here rather than half-fixed. Level chart was inverted against the packet chart and its own explanations; flipped as one atomic group in both layers with unchanged rows included so the group is complete. Irelia's E carries a 'grounding' derived flag that Riot's description does not support — not asserted anywhere on the page.
